record.title: Select acquisition from observed specimen layout
record.intent: Choose bounded logical and raw acquisition tasks based on observed access, size and storage topology.
requirements: Identify exact source devices, sizes, destination capacity and acquisition permissions from evidence, keeping logical corpus and raw image separate.

A running mounted filesystem is a live acquisition; do not promise identical whole-device hashes across reads or atomic filesystem consistency. Preserve discrepancies without rewriting earlier evidence.

If sufficient ordinary access exists, draft plan inspect admit and commit bounded acquisition successors within operator authorization. Otherwise record the precise permission or access boundary and stop.
Keep physical entitlement changes and physical capability transformation outside this acquisition batch; software research serves specimen accession and emulator validation.
acceptance: An evidence-backed bounded acquisition continuation or exact blocker is recorded.
